name: Paradox Idol
source:
Just as the idol group you manage is about to debut, one member quits. You're forced to take his place. Will you become a true K-pop idol?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
正当你管理的偶像团体即将出道时，一名成员退出了。你被迫取代他的位置。你会成为真正的韩国流行偶像吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
